findings.what: removeWaitlistEntry sets a pending offer to 'closed'; sweepExpiredOffers only processes 'pending' offers, so the freed slot is never passed to the next patient in the queue
The v1 reassignAppointment does not check the target doctor's leave or working hours, so staff can reassign a booked appointment onto a doctor who is on leave (the new reassignOne path does check)
The offered slot is not held while the offer is pending; an online booker can take it, and the offer then fails even though the email promised the slot
